newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: No offers for Hanbo, auction put off.
newsitem.headline: No offers for Hanbo, auction put off.

text.p: Korea First Bank said on Monday no offers had been submitted to buy the failed Hanbo Steel Co and an auction would be put off until the end of this month.
The deadline to submit applications to bid for Hanbo was 4.30 p.m. (0730 GMT) on Monday. An auction originally was scheduled for July 8.
"No companies showed up. We will now set a date for the next auction," said Kang Won-kyung, an official in the public relations department of Korea First, Hanbo's main creditor.
"But the current strict requirements will not be eased in the next auction," Kang added.
Hyundai Group and 10 other conglomerates joined a briefing session on the auction on July 1.
